jobs.title: Director of Platform Management for Simulation, Evaluation & Validation
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

The Role

As Director of Platform Management for Simulation, Evaluation & Validation
, you will lead the overall product vision and director for the platforms that Wayve uses to develop, evaluate, and validate the AI Driver. This includes open and closed loop simulation platforms, the evaluation test platform, synthetic data production, critical event pipelines, validation, and the workflows that connect them.

You will directly lead and indirectly influence sub team platform leads across Simulation, Evaluation, Data, and Validation to convert a complex set of cross-cutting initiatives into a single, opinionated product strategy. The job is part developer-tools PM (your users are engineers and scientists who will tell you immediately when something is slow, wrong, or in the way), part platform PM (your roadmap has to compose across simulators, datasets, evaluation, and triage), and part safety-systems PM (the outputs gate releases that put cars on real roads).

You will help shape and set vision for how our tools and services should function and work in an AV2.0 context - a Wayve-pioneered approach to both the driving stack and offline development.

Key Responsibilities

Set product vision and strategy for the platforms. Define a multi-year, multi-quarter product strategy that takes Wayve from a collection of capable tools to a unified, opinionated platform for evaluating and validating the AI Driver. Anchor the strategy in measurable customer outcomes — developer velocity, signal quality, cost per evaluation, time-to-insight, validation credibility.
Own the product roadmap end-to-end. Translate company-level priorities into a coherent roadmap across simulation, evaluation, and validation initiatives. Drive trade-offs between different internal and external customer groups. Ensure resourcing decisions are clearly communicated to other director level stakeholders.
Lead and grow the team. Manage and mentor the product managers embedded across. Hire to fill gaps, level up the craft, and build a highly capable lean team.
Build world class developer experiences. Run regular user research with Autonomy, Science, Validation, Release, and Product teams. Maintain a clear picture of what each customer segment needs from the platform, where the friction is, and which gaps are quietly bleeding velocity.
Define and defend quality bars for an internal platform. Set platform-wide standards for reliability, latency, cost per unit (per simulation, per evaluation, per enriched hour), self-service, observability, and API stability. Treat platform regressions the way a consumer team treats a churn spike.
Establish regular operational cadences. Lead monthly business reviews and close the loop on requests and progress reporting with the leadership team. Lead quarterly planning, KPI reviews, and the trade-off conversations.
Represent the platform externally. Help Wayve's leadership tell a credible story about how we develop and validate the AI Driver — to OEM partners, regulators, and at relevant industry forums.

About You

In order to set you up for success at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential

8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3–5 years leading PM teams (PMs and/or senior PMs reporting to you).
Track record building internal platforms, developer tools, or ML/AI evaluation infrastructure — products whose users are engineers and scientists, where the bar is set by power users with strong opinions and the ability to route around you if the tool isn't good enough.
Data driven. You always seek to answer questions with data and lean into defining the right customer facing KPIs indicative of success
Systems thinking across hardware, AI, and product. You understand how decisions in one part of the stack (data, simulator fidelity, metric design) propagate into outcomes (release confidence, on-road performance, regulator trust) elsewhere.
Insight-driven leader. A record of producing the analysis or framing that changed a "go/no-go" decision on a complex AI or robotics program.
Product craft. You care about workflows, latency, errors-per-hour, and how a tool feels. You apply product management best practices to measuring user experience.
AI Fluency. You not only regularly use but are a standard bearer in the application of AI tools to the job.

Desirable

Prior experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, or another safety-critical AI/ML program (L2+, L4, surgical robotics, aerospace autonomy, etc.).
Familiarity with simulation, synthetic data, evaluation harnesses, or ML observability tools at production scale.
Working knowledge of SOTIF (ISO 21448), ISO 26262, or other safety standards relevant to validating learned systems.
Experience with internal developer platforms (CI/CD, ML platforms, data platforms) at scale.

This is a full-time role based in-office. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home.

The reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $332,000 to $415,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in our interview process, please let us know.

We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve.

To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

For US candidates only, please visit E-Verify Notice and Participation and Right to Work

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Engineering Manager — News Engineering @ LSEG

Help us shape the future of real-time news delivery
and join a team powering the heartbeat of global information! LSEG’s News Engineering group is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager
to evolve our News platform, delivering enriched, structured breaking news with metadata, entities, and context to customers worldwide in sub‑second time. If you're motivated by high-performance systems, real-world impact, and incorporating modern engineering practices in a dynamic and forward-thinking environment — this is your opportunity.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineering manager who combines strong people leadership, hands‑on technical credibility, and sound execution judgment
. You will partner closely with product, architecture, and other engineering leaders to deliver reliable outcomes while evolving a content‑ and data‑driven news platform sustainably.

As a senior engineering manager in the News team at LSEG, you will be accountable for delivery, quality, reliability, and operational outcomes
across one or more
News Engineering squads responsible for content enrichment and real‑time delivery. You’ll hire, onboard, and develop engineers at varying levels, building high‑performing, inclusive teams
. Coach engineers through regular feedback, career development, and performance management. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, learning, and continuous improvement
. Create an environment where on‑call and operational responsibilities are sustainable and well‑engineered
, not hero‑driven.

As a technical leader, you’ll be hands-on in design and problem
‑
solving
, guiding implementation decisions without being the primary implementer. Review and challenge designs
to ensure performance, reliability, correctness, and operability standards are met, particularly for content processing
and NLP‑driven enrichment systems
. Support engineers in making pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long‑term health
. Ensure teams apply modern engineering practices to content‑centric systems, including automated testing
of NLP pipelines, observability
of data quality and model behavior, and CI/CD
for both code and content processing. Guide effective, responsible use of AI‑assisted development
and content intelligence tools to improve productivity and code quality.

Technical Skills We’re Looking For

Solid technical background in backend or platform engineering (e.g. Java, Python, Linux environments)
Experience managing teams delivering distributed, real‑time, or high‑availability systems
Solid understanding of low‑latency architectures and operational considerations
Familiarity with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, cloud infrastructure)
Experience using and guiding teams in the adoption of AI‑assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot)
Experience with news or content‑driven systems, including text processing, metadata enrichment, entity extraction, classification, or other applied NLP techniques
Strong communication skills, especially around design decisions, risks, and tradeoffs

Why Join Us?

Impact: Your work helps deliver critical news to financial professionals in real-time.
Growth: Learn from expert engineers and expand your skills across cloud, data, and resilient systems.
Culture: We value curiosity over dogma, ownership over handoffs, and pragmatism over perfection. You’ll work in a globally distributed team that supports each other.
Flexibility: Hybrid work options and a balanced work-life environment.

Career Stage:

Manager

Compensation/Benefits Information:

LSEG is committed to offering competitive Compensation and Benefits. The anticipated base salary for this position is $147,500 - $245,900.

Please be aware base salary ranges may vary by geographic location, city and state. In addition to our offered base salary, this role is eligible for our Annual Incentive Plan (AIP/”bonus plan”). Target AIP rates will be commensurate with role level and posted career stage. Individual salary will be reflective of job related knowledge, skills and equivalent experience. LSEG roles (excluding internships and part-time roles of less than 20 hours per week) are typically eligible for inclusion in our LSEG Benefits program, which includes offerings of: Annual Wellness Allowance, Paid time-off, Medical, Dental, Vision, Flex Spending & Health Savings Options, Prescription Drug plan, 401(K) Savings Plan and Company match. LSEG’s Benefits plan also includes basic life insurance, disability benefits, emergency backup dependent care, adoption assistance commuter assistance etc.

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership
, Excellence
and Change
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

Whether you’re designing solutions, telling our story, or setting our teams up for success, your work makes a difference every single day. What You'll Do - You'll Make The Moment

Technical Architecture & Hands-On Leadership

Drive the evolution of our data architecture to support scalability, reliability, and performance with a Snowflake-first mindset, including data modeling standards, ELT patterns, warehouse strategy, security, performance optimization, and cost governance.
Remain technically hands-on as needed by designing solutions, reviewing code, modeling data, and guiding implementation decisions to ensure quality and consistency across the platform.

Team Leadership & Planning

Demonstrated Management/Leadership skill that can inspire and motivate
Excellent communication for technical and non-technical team members
Solid technology knowledge leveraging cloud-based solutions, with continued desire to learn
IT project management techniques and methodologies with proven ability to plan, prioritize, deliver work using Agile framework
IT project management techniques and methodologies
Experience with tools such as: Azure/AWS, Snowflake, Data Stage/Informatica, Alteryx/Dataiku/Databricks or similar platforms

jobs.title: Sr Manager or Principal, Generation Interconnection & Grid Engineering
jobs.description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

Position Summary

Antora is seeking a Sr Manager or Principal, Interconnection & Grid Engineering to lead the technical execution of generation interconnection processes for Antora's thermal energy storage projects across multiple RTOs/ISOs (MISO, SPP, ERCOT, and others as the portfolio expands). This is a hands-on role: the person in this seat will own interconnection applications and studies end to end, direct the consultants who perform detailed modeling work, and bring independent technical judgment to configuration, sizing, and de-risking decisions long before a project reaches a formal queue.

The ideal candidate combines deep power systems engineering fundamentals (one-line diagrams, load flow, short circuit, stability, and dynamic modeling) with practical fluency in how interconnection actually works inside each RTO/ISO — the paperwork, the study milestones, the informal norms, and the levers available to move a project faster or cheaper. This role partners closely with Antora's transmission strategy, project development, and policy teams, and is central to translating a proposed project site into a technically sound, de-risked interconnected project.

Roles & Responsibilities

Interconnection Process Leadership
Lead and manage the end-to-end interconnection process for Antora projects across MISO, SPP, ERCOT, and other RTOs/ISOs as needed, including application preparation, queue entry, and milestone tracking through each required study phase.
Serve as Antora's primary technical point of contact with RTO/ISO interconnection staff, transmission owners, and utilities on study scope, assumptions, and results.
Navigate the distinct interconnection rules, tariffs, cluster study cycles, and procedural requirements unique to each RTO/ISO, and translate those differences into practical guidance for internal teams.
Track and manage financial postings, security deposits, milestone deliverables, and agreement obligations (e.g., GIA/LGIA/ISA) across the interconnection portfolio.

Technical Studies & Engineering

Develop and maintain single-line diagrams (SLDs) for proposed interconnection configurations, from early feasibility concepts through formal application submittals.
Run and/or critically review stability, dynamic, load flow, and short-circuit studies to evaluate system impacts of proposed interconnections and to stress-test third-party study results.
Evaluate sizing and configuration options (e.g., point of interconnection, voltage level, equipment arrangement) to identify the optimal technical and commercial path for each project.
Interpret utility and RTO study results (system impact studies, facilities studies, deliverability analyses) and translate findings into clear implications for cost, schedule, and project viability.

Consultant & Vendor Management

Direct and manage external engineering consultants performing interconnection studies, modeling, and SLD development, ensuring technical rigor, schedule adherence, and cost discipline.
Scope consultant engagements, review deliverables for quality and completeness, and hold vendors accountable to Antora's technical standards.

Early-Stage De-Risking

Partner with site selection and project development teams to assess interconnection feasibility and technical risk before sites are committed, using hosting capacity data, prior study history, and engineering judgment.
Identify and flag interconnection risks (e.g., restudy exposure, network upgrade cost drivers, deliverability constraints) early enough to influence site selection, project sequencing, and commercial terms.
Build and maintain repeatable frameworks, checklists, and tools to standardize how Antora screens and de-risks new interconnection opportunities across RTOs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with the transmission strategy, project development, policy, and commercial teams to align interconnection execution with broader tariff and siting strategy.
Communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to non-technical internal stakeholders and senior leadership.

Key Qualifications

8+ years of experience in power systems engineering, interconnection studies, or transmission planning, with direct experience managing interconnection applications through one or more RTOs/ISOs.
Demonstrated experience developing single-line diagrams and running or critically reviewing load flow, short-circuit, stability, and dynamic studies.
Working knowledge of commercial power system modeling tools (e.g., PSS/E, PSLF, PowerWorld, PSCAD, ASPEN, or equivalent).
Strong understanding of FERC, NERC, and RTO/ISO interconnection processes, tariffs, and cluster study frameworks, with direct experience in at least one of MISO, SPP, or ERCOT.
Experience managing or directing external engineering consultants on technical deliverables.
Proven ability to independently evaluate interconnection configuration and sizing tradeoffs and make sound technical recommendations under ambiguity.
Experience interconnecting storage, generation, or large flexible loads, particularly co-located or hybrid configurations.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical analysis into clear risk and decision guidance for cross-functional and executive audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (Power Systems focus) or related field.

Additional Qualifications Desired

Experience across multiple RTOs/ISOs (e.g., MISO, SPP, ERCOT, PJM, CAISO).
Prior experience working directly for an RTO/ISO, transmission owner, or utility transmission planning group.
Familiarity with network upgrade cost allocation methodologies and deliverability/capacity accreditation frameworks.
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Coding proficiency (e.g., Python) for study automation, data analysis, or power system tool APIs.

Work Location: Remote, US

Salary Range: $188,000 USD - $265,000 USD

Salary Basis: Annual

Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

jobs.description:
Senior Director, Product Management - Consumer & Developer Experience

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About The Team

At Capital One, the Consumer & Developer Experience (CDX) team brings Product, Tech, and Design together to build and scale innovative products and user-obsessed platforms that inspire trust and loyalty. Driven by a mission to create unparalleled digital connections, we deliver transformative, customer-centric experiences that empower users throughout their financial journeys while directly accelerating business growth. As part of CDX, you will sit at the intersection of customer empathy and enterprise scale, shaping foundational platforms and best-in-class products that define how millions of customers interact with Capital One every day.

Our team is scaling significantly across several core strategic pillars to drive impact across AI, platform infrastructure, and greenfield products:

Developer Experience (DevX): Building AI tools and platforms that transform how our engineering teams build and operate software.
Marketing & Messaging Delivery (MMD): Owning high-throughput communication engines that deliver billions of real-time interactions.
Experience Platforms (XP): Driving quality and UI/UX consistency across all customer-facing digital channels.
Enterprise Services & Supplier Product, Risk & Operations (ESPRO): Leading greenfield initiatives from the ground up to build first-of-its-kind enterprise supplier and operational platforms.

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment
